name: Tsapa Payment Gateway for MTN Mobile Money in Africa
author: tsapa

sections.description:
Grow your business with secure MTN Mobile Money payments across Africa.

Unlike payment services that first collect your money before sending it to you, Tsapa Payment Gateway connects directly to your own MTN Mobile Money merchant account using your official MTN credentials.

Your payment flow is simple:

Customer → MTN Mobile Money → Your MTN Mobile Money Merchant Account

No intermediary wallet.

No third-party payment processor holding your funds.

Just your WooCommerce store, your MTN Mobile Money merchant account and your customer.

Whether you sell physical products, digital products, subscriptions or professional services, Tsapa provides a secure and reliable payment experience built specifically for African businesses.

Why Choose Tsapa?

✔ Direct integration with MTN Mobile Money.

✔ Payments go directly to your own MTN Mobile Money merchant account.

✔ No third-party payment processor holding your funds.

✔ Official MTN Mobile Money API integration.

✔ Sandbox mode for safe testing.

✔ Live production mode.

✔ Easy WooCommerce setup.

✔ No coding required.

✔ Secure payment processing.

✔ Lightweight and fast.

✔ Built specifically for African businesses.

✔ Regular updates and continuous improvements.

Supported Countries

Where MTN Mobile Money operates, Tsapa helps you accept payments.

Currently supported countries include:

• Rwanda

• Uganda

• Ghana

• Zambia

• Cameroon

• Côte d’Ivoire

• Benin

• Liberia

• Republic of Congo

• Guinea-Bissau

• Eswatini

Support for additional MTN Mobile Money markets will continue to grow.

Get Started in Minutes

  1. Install and activate the plugin.

  2. Enable Tsapa Payment Gateway in WooCommerce.

  3. Create your free MTN MoMo Developer account.

  4. Generate your Sandbox API credentials.

  5. Test your payment flow.

  6. Request Production credentials from your local MTN operating company.

  7. Switch to Live Mode and start accepting real customer payments.

Need API Credentials?

Create your free MTN MoMo Developer account here:

https://momodeveloper.mtn.com/

After creating your application, you’ll receive Sandbox credentials for testing.

When you’re ready to accept real payments, request Production access from your local MTN operating company and replace your Sandbox credentials with your Live credentials.

Support

Need help?

Contact the Tsapa team for assistance with installation, MTN API setup, Sandbox testing, Live Mode activation, or general questions.

Email: info@tsapa.rw

External Services

This plugin communicates with the MTN Mobile Money (MoMo) API to request and verify customer payments.

Data transmitted includes:

• Customer phone number

• Payment amount

• Currency

• Transaction reference

• Payment description

Data is transmitted only when a customer initiates a payment.

MTN MoMo Developer Portal:
https://momodeveloper.mtn.com/

Privacy Policy:
https://momodeveloper.mtn.com/privacy-policy
sections.faq:
Can I test payments before going live?

Yes. Sandbox mode allows you to test your complete payment flow without using real money.

Do I need coding experience?

No. Everything is configured directly from your WooCommerce settings page.

How do I start accepting real payments?

Once your MTN Mobile Money production account has been approved, enter your Live API credentials and switch the plugin from Sandbox Mode to Live Mode.

Which countries are supported?

Rwanda, Uganda, Ghana, Zambia, Cameroon, Côte d’Ivoire, Benin, Liberia, Republic of Congo, Guinea-Bissau and Eswatini.

Does this plugin store customer PINs or Mobile Money passwords?

No. Customer authentication is securely handled by MTN Mobile Money. Sensitive payment credentials are never stored by this plugin.
